source_reviews.name: card_ixalans_binding
source_reviews.reason: Restore separate native instance/i/td/pos scopes, split name/IID/result temporaries and share the same ETB/oblivion continuation across event arms. Keep humiliation before getter, live info_slot bound after name checks, fresh affected controller after has_same_name, saved pos before get_card_name, live selected target after that callback and count store after obliviation. Event is by value, so moving common setup does not merge dynamic calls.

Preserve the getter after humiliation, attachment guards, in_play query even for the enchanted index, conditional creature query and live active-card bound after callbacks. The final aura continuation remains unconditional.

source_reviews.reason: Restore the native DWARF selected local name. Keep amount/count-deck snapshot, five-card cap, tutor before decrement/reveal and the saved remaining amount passed to bottom-of-deck afterward. No callback, bound or return behavior changes.

source_reviews.name: effect_unearth
source_reviews.reason: Restore native p/c coordinates and keep legacy versus reanimated instance pointers separate. Preserve coordinates captured before haste, live legacy fields after callbacks, original IID snapshot before the later getter/owner-state read, and the EOT marker store before reanimated getter/exile. The original IID and upkeep boolean no longer share one result local.

source_reviews.name: reyhan_last_of_the_abzan_effect
source_reviews.reason: Restore native DWARF iterations name for the inner extraction loop; result, instance, recorded, stored, sc, i, td, amount and msg are already retained. Keep native VLA extent, per-field extraction/reset order, count rereads and callbacks, including existing native zero-extent/duplicate-counter quirks. No buffer-size or rules changes.

source_reviews.name: card_harvester_troll
source_reviews.reason: Reconstruct the native block-scoped100-byte zero-filled string initializer instead of a full memset followed by a40-byte memcpy and dead result assignment. The native literal at0x2739128 is exactly39 text bytes plus NUL; native instructions copy40 then zero60 bytes before test initialization. The C initializer has identical contents and lifetime across the same calls, without forcing stack layout.
